donaghadee male choir will sing at the 12 noon mass in christ the king church, limavady, on sunday 25 october , as part of the city of derry international choir sacred trail . the donaghadee male voice choir is a long-established choir from the seaside town of donaghadee in county down and was founded in 1932. the sacred trail brings together local and visiting choirs, sharing the beauty of choral music through services of worship across the city and surrounding areas.
